select *
from "ClothingItem" t0
join "ClothingSession" t1 on t0."clothingSessionId" = t1."id"
join "SellerProfile" t2 on t1."sellerProfileId" = t2."id"
join "User" t3 on t2."userId" = t3."id"
limit 50;
